notes.title: 🪐 Starium Enters Early Access on September 11!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340227/5bcabd75e4dbc2f590db262ca1decdfd3decdc88.png"][/img][/p][p]
We’re excited to announce that [b]Starium enters Early Access on September 11, 2025![/b][/p][p]In [i]Starium[/i], you’ll step into a galaxy where the rare fuel “[b]Starium[/b]” is mined from dying stars at a terrible cost. As a newcomer, you’ll explore hostile worlds, battle powerful foes, and make choices that shape the fate of the galaxy.[/p][h2]What’s included in Early Access:[/h2][list][*][p]⚔️ [b]30+ Weapons[/b] with unique, stackable effects[/p][/*][*][p]🛡️ [b]55+ Armor Pieces[/b] to create wild synergies[/p][/*][*][p]👾 [b]25+ Challenging Bosses[/b] that test your skills[/p][/*][*][p]🌍 [b]Explorable Open World[/b] with dungeons and secrets[/p][/*][*][p]🎭 [b]Branching Choices & Quests[/b] that ripple across Talara[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]This is just the beginning of the journey. Early Access lets us build [i]Starium[/i] with you, the players! expanding the world with new quests, bosses, items, and systems on the road to full release in Q1 2026.[/p][p]👉 Wishlist Starium on Steam and prepare to dive in on [b]September 11[/b].[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3327700/Starium/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: 🚀 Starium Demo Now Available! 💥
notes.content:
[b]Greetings, explorers![/b]

We're thrilled to announce that the demo for Starium is now live on Steam! Step into the stars and get a first taste of our sci-fi, open-world RPG bullet hell—a 2D top-down pixel art experience where every shot counts and every choice matters.

So go on—download the demo, suit up, and take your first step into the cosmos.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3589850/Starium_Demo/


and if you have any feedback about the game please fill in this form get the chance to be among the winners of 10 keys of the full game on release. 

https://forms.gle/XyLEmWjKtTyuscHj9




See you in TALARA.
